name: Modular Molding International, Inc., d/b/a A&M Engineering

about:
Modular Molding International, Inc. (MMI), doing business as A&M Engineering, operates from Largo, Florida. The company was founded in 1991 as a one-person operation and has grown under the leadership of Frank Meola, who has served as president for 26 years and brings over 40 years of plastic injection molding experience.

MMI designs and manufactures plastic injection molds and provides injection molding services. Its in-house design team uses CAD and SolidWorks for 3D modeling, while precision tool building occurs in its own tooling facilities. The company runs a fleet of advanced injection molding machines at its U.S. facilities and also operates a fully-owned production facility in China. Process control relies on eDART system software, and quality inspection employs automated vision systems and robotic arms. MMI follows Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) protocols and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The company serves automotive, consumer products, and general manufacturing customers worldwide. Automotive clients receive PPAP-compliant parts, while the modular molding system patented in 2003 supports flexible prototyping and customization across industries.

MMI emphasizes its commitment to American manufacturing alongside its overseas facility to balance cost savings with quality control. The patented modular molding system, sustainable practices using eDART to reduce waste, and a customer-first philosophy centered on defect-free, on-time delivery form the core of its differentiation.
